projectDescription: TanaFlows is a premium Ghost CMS theme built for multilingual publishing, affiliate marketers, and SaaS creators, featuring smart search, course pages, SEO schemas, and AI-ready integrations.
keyFeatures: Multilingual Ghost CMS support with subdirectory routing
Smart Search with fuzzy matching and instant results
Smart Related Posts with multi-tier matching algorithm
5 built-in automated SEO schemas (Breadcrumb, Course, FAQ, Review, Product)
AI-Ready Integration Suite (Copy as Markdown, ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini one-click share)
Author Biolink page (Linktree-style personal landing page)
Course page templates supporting YouTube, Vimeo, BunnyCDN, HTML5, Alugha, Mux, Loom
Child Search (tag-scoped and full-text search via FuseJS)
9 comment system integrations (Giscus, Disqus, Ghost, Cusdis, Commento, Telegram, etc.)
publicApiSurface: Ghost Custom Settings: multilingual enable/disable toggle
Ghost Custom Settings: languages list (format: language_code|Display_Name)
Ghost Custom Settings: root URL configuration
Ghost Custom Settings: comment provider selection
Internal tag #multilingual — links translated posts
Internal tag #newsletter — marks newsletter posts for homepage section
Internal tag #product — marks product pages for mega menu
Internal tag #changelog — marks changelog posts
Internal tag #comment — adds comment section to any page
Internal tag #faq-schema — activates FAQ structured data
Internal tag #faq-schema-toggle — FAQ schema via Ghost toggle cards
Internal tag #no-toc — hides table of contents on specific posts
Internal tag #no-homepage — hides post from homepage
Internal tag #no-featured — hides post from featured section
Internal tag #review — activates Review schema markup
Course LMS tags: #youtube, #vimeo, #bunny, #htmlvideo, #alugha, #mux, #loom, #textcourse
Author biolink config via internal tag Description field (Title|Bio|CTA Label|CTA URL)
Author biolink links via internal tag Meta Description (Name|URL, Name|URL)
window.lessons[] JavaScript array for course page lesson list injection
Custom routes (routes.yaml) for curated page templates
